Class ExpressionOperator

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.evaluate.operator.OperatorBase
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.evaluate.expression.tree.ExpressionOperator
All Implemented Interfaces:
IOperator
public class ExpressionOperator extends OperatorBase
An operator defined by an expression tree with parameters. The parameters of the expression are the inputs of this operator.
